text: The Four-Party Accountability System for Underground Flooding Zones is a strategic initiative by the South Korean government to enhance operational control and accountability for flood-prone underpasses. This system assigns clear responsibilities to multi-agency teams, including road authorities, local government officials, village heads, and police officers, to manage real-time monitoring, alerts, and rapid response actions. It is part of a broader national disaster mitigation package aimed at reducing risks associated with rapid-onset urban flash flooding during monsoon periods.
